_comment: Components of the Any360 layer and their state, kept by hand (tools/progress_page.py reads it). States: done (in this repository, usable by another title), in progress, planned, game-specific (stays in the title's repository; listed so the boundary is visible). 'source' is where the component exists today.

components.name: Pinned ReXGlue baseline (v0.10.0) and patch application rules
components.note: move the scripts, keep the hashes; the game repository keeps only its game manifest

components.name: Kernel / XAM fixes (0001, 0003, 0008, 0059-0061, 0065, 0066, 0070, 0086, 0087)
components.note: generic as they are; 0060 and 0087 fix real bugs any title may hit

components.name: Codegen patches: vpkd3d128 in place, bit-exact vrsqrtefp, single-rounding FMA (0005, 0052, 0095)
components.note: the helpers are emitted into the generated <game>_pch.h, so they need no SDK header change

components.name: Audio: XMA context fixes and callback pacing (0004, 0007, 0050, 0051, 0096)
components.note: the Simpsons title drives the XMA contexts through the kernel API directly: these matter there first

components.name: Threading, clock and wait patches (0015-0021, 0026-0028, 0033, 0068, 0069)
components.note: generic; the Linux-only ones are the Steam Deck's

components.name: GPU shared-layer performance patches (0024, 0025, 0030-0034, 0041-0049, 0078-0080, 0097-0100, 0106-0113)
components.note: command processor, caches, cached indirect buffers, draw identity memo, frame stats and draw trace

components.name: Vulkan backend patches (0011, 0013, 0014, 0038-0040, 0043, 0046, 0049, 0053, 0058, 0114-0128)
components.note: the Windows Vulkan build (0114), dynamic uniform buffers (0122: +20-25% FPS), timers by section, occlusion queries in render passes

components.name: D3D12 backend patches (0006, 0010, 0035-0037, 0042, 0045, 0048, 0057, 0081-0083, 0088, 0090, 0099, 0101-0103)
components.note: kept for Windows users of the emulation path; not on the native renderer's path (Vulkan only)

components.name: Input: keyboard and mouse through XInputGetKeystroke and mouse look (0054, 0055, 0094)
components.note: generic with the per-title keybinds kept in the game

components.name: HLE frame ABI: rex_gpu_hle_submit_frame(const HleFrameAbi*), version 4
components.note: the contract between a title's records and the plugin; both copies checked equal by a test

components.name: Draw record model: RecordKind, DrawRecord, shared immutable state blocks
components.note: source-agnostic: filled by D3D hooks (Crackdown) or by a PM4 decode in the plugin (Simpsons plan)

components.name: PM4 decoder: Xenos type-0/type-3 packets to state writes, draws, shader loads, bin predication, indirect buffers
components.note: header-only, no game knowledge; the opcode allow-list is the XDK D3D runtime's

components.name: Render pass markers in the command stream ('HLEM' NOP) and per-pass accounting
components.note: pass ids and names come from the title

components.name: Native pass pipeline in the Vulkan plugin: dry run to pipelines, native depth pass, depth comparison with the emulated target
components.note: validated exact for static geometry on the shadow atlas (2026-10-29)

components.name: XDK D3D runtime binding: entry points (draw, clear, resolve, RunCommandBuffer, GPR flush) found by signature instead of by address
components.source: crackdown: docs/progress/d3d_entry_points.txt (209 addresses); simpsons: re/d3d_method_table.md (174 signature matches)
components.note: the step that makes the renderer hooks portable between titles built with the same XDK

components.name: GPU feature census from a running title (PM4 opcodes, shader instruction families, formats, MSAA, memexport, queries)
components.note: what the coverage tool cannot see statically

components.name: Guest sandbox: run recompiled leaf functions outside the game in a lazily committed 4 GB guest space
components.note: the golden files hold addresses, inputs and outputs only

components.name: SDK patch guards: tests that fail when a patched behaviour is lost at a rebase
Coverage: imports and instructions a title needs vs what the SDK provides
components.note: run on Crackdown and The Simpsons Game

components.name: Patch inventory and progress page
Crash mapping: host crash address to guest function and instruction
Missing-function finder: code reached only through pointers the analyzer missed
components.source: crackdown: tools/find-missing-functions.py; simpsons: functions_patch.toml (found with an LD_PRELOAD trap)
components.note: both titles needed it; one tool

components.name: Render pass hooks and names (29 passes), D3D entry point addresses, shader object offsets, device shadow layout
components.note: becomes an XDK-version table once the binding above exists

components.name: Settings, launcher, achievements, cheats, save compatibility, title updates
components.note: stays in each title's repository
